purpose: Trace every Step 2 catalogue media path to its original source repository.
limitations: GitHub connector permissions are read-only and do not expose repository binary archives to the local runtime.
The Step 2 browser smoke harness intercepts raw GitHub image requests with a test fixture to test UI behaviors, not the real image content.
Step 3 must obtain the full source archives, compare hashes, validate image decoding/dimensions, then move selected binaries under the local assets tree and remove runtime raw-host dependency.
